mapper.sql: s.id, s.title, s.description, s.schedule_date, s.starts_at, s.ends_at, s.location, s.category, s.target_audience, s.is_active, s.display_order, s.collect_participation, option.id AS participation_option_id, COALESCE(option_count.selection_count, 0) AS selection_count, s.created_by_admin_id, created_admin.email AS created_by_admin_email, created_admin.name AS created_by_admin_name, created_admin.role AS created_by_admin_role, s.updated_by_admin_id, updated_admin.email AS updated_by_admin_email, updated_admin.name AS updated_by_admin_name, updated_admin.role AS updated_by_admin_role, s.created_at, s.updated_at

FROM retreat_schedule_items s LEFT JOIN admin_users created_admin ON created_admin.id = s.created_by_admin_id LEFT JOIN admin_users updated_admin ON updated_admin.id = s.updated_by_admin_id LEFT JOIN retreat_participation_options option ON option.schedule_item_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT selection.option_id, COUNT(*) AS selection_count FROM registration_participation_options selection JOIN registrations registration ON registration.id = selection.registration_id WHERE registration.status = 'REGISTERED' GROUP BY selection.option_id ) option_count ON option_count.option_id = option.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retreat_schedule_items ( retreat_id, title, description, schedule_date, starts_at, ends_at, location, category, target_audience, is_active, display_order, collect_participation, created_by_admin_id, updated_by_admin_id ) VALUES ( (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN')), #{title}, #{description}, #{scheduleDate}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{location}, #{category}, #{targetAudience}, #{active}, #{displayOrder}, #{collectParticipation}, #{adminId}, #{adminId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE retreat_schedule_items SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, location = #{location}, category = #{category}, target_audience = #{targetAudience}, is_active = #{active}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, collect_participation = #{collectParticipation}, updated_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND retreat_id = ( SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN') )

UPDATE retreat_schedule_items SET is_active = #{active}, updated_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND retreat_id = ( SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN') )

UPDATE retreat_schedule_items SET schedule_date = schedule_date + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER), starts_at = starts_at + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 day', ends_at = ends_at + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER) * INTERVAL '1 day', is_active = is_active AND schedule_date + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER) BETWEEN #{startsOn} AND #{endsOn}, updated_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, updated_at = now() WHERE retreat_id = #{retreatId}

UPDATE retreat_participation_options option SET option_type = CASE WHEN schedule.category = 'MEAL' THEN 'MEAL' ELSE 'PROGRAM' END, label = schedule.title, event_date = schedule.schedule_date, display_order = schedule.display_order, is_active = schedule.is_active AND schedule.collect_participation, updated_at = now() FROM retreat_schedule_items schedule WHERE option.schedule_item_id = schedule.id AND schedule.retreat_id = #{retreatId}
